title: Cisco Secure Email Gateway: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 24 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched. Ready-made attack tools are public. It affects a product that faces the internet or gives remote access. The severity score is critical (9.8).

category.label: Email
category.why: It carries internal and customer mail.
category.doThis: Patch it, or ask your email provider whether they have.

summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway contains a relative path traversal vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying operating system.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 17, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.
